verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.livekit.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Doc pages are served as Markdown (.md endpoints, probe-verified), and the docs state LiveKit is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Together this gives agents clear entry points for agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
